nodes.label: Pending bookings review screen
Approve booking captures the pre-authorised card payment and activates the rental
Reject booking releases the payment hold and notifies the customer with an optional reason
Pre-authorisation expiry countdown badge (preauth_expires_at, urgent at <=1 day)
Identity verification status surfaced at approval time, including manually_verified (ID waiver)
Monthly P&L drill-down page
Per-vehicle profit/loss breakdown for a single month
Rationale: tenant predicate on pnl_entries is mandatory — the optional form leaked every tenant's P&L
P&L filter context carried through URL params: dashboard -> month -> vehicle P&L tab
Global P&L dashboard page
Fleet-wide profitability aggregation computed client-side from pnl_entries
P&L side/category taxonomy (Revenue: Rental, Initial Fees; Cost: Service, Fines, Acquisition, Other)
Disposed vehicles keep their P&L history but display a Disposed status instead of profit/loss
Plate detail page
Plate detail query carries no tenant predicate and its query key omits tenant — relies purely on RLS
plates carries two vehicle links: detail joins assigned_vehicle_id, list joins/writes vehicle_id
Plates list never links to /plates/[id] — rows deep-link to the vehicle instead, leaving plate detail URL-only
Plates management list page
Licence plate lifecycle: ordered -> received -> assigned (fitted = legacy) -> expired, with assign/unassign and delete-blocked-when-assigned rules
Plate unassign/expire writes a vehicle_events audit row typed 'expense_added' (event type does not match the action)
Plates paginate in memory over the full unbounded query result
Promotions manager page
Promotional offer management: percentage/fixed discount, date window, optional promo code and hero image
Promotion status derived from is_active plus the start/end window: inactive | scheduled | active | expired
Promotion artwork uploaded to the shared cms-media storage bucket (5MB, image types only)
Destructive-confirmation dialogs log an audit event the moment the warning is shown (useAuditLogOnOpen)
Reminders analytics page
Reminder insight charts: severity donut, category bar, critical-rate radial, 6-month creation trend
Portal analytics convention: a sibling /analytics route rendering ChartContainer+recharts cards with fixed hex palettes and an Info tooltip per chart
Reminders inbox page
Fleet compliance reminder inbox with severity/type filters and per-object deep links (Vehicle, Customer, Rental, Fine, Integration)
Integration-type reminders are Bonzah balance monitors: branded logo row, no due dates, Triggered/Monitoring state, links to Settings > Insurance
Bulk mark-done / dismiss over selected reminders with an auto-generated note
Manager per-tab write gating: every mutating control is wrapped in canEdit('<tab_key>')
Rentals analytics page
Rental portfolio analytics: status mix, duration buckets, revenue per status, weekly creation trend
Review funnel over completed rentals only: Reviewed / Pending Review / Skipped
computed_status is the single derived rental state (Active/Completed/Pending/Cancelled/Upcoming/Rejected) shared by list, calendar and analytics
Rentals list page
Rental row alert precedence: extension requested > cancellation requested > Bonzah insufficient_balance > Bonzah quoted
Pay-as-you-go (open-ended, 'Ongoing') and auto-extend/paused states shown as rental badges
List/calendar view is URL state (?view=calendar) and suppresses stat cards and filters
formatTimeOfDay renders raw Postgres TIME values as 12-hour clock, returning null so callers skip the line
Reports & exports hub page
Reporting reads pre-aggregated Postgres views rather than base tables, all filtered on tenant_id
Server-side export pipeline: generate-export returns csv/pdf inline and xlsx base64-decoded in the browser
Aging receivables bypasses the preview modal for an inline detail view (0-30/31-60/61-90/90+ buckets)
America/New_York is hard-coded as the reporting/display timezone regardless of tenant locale
Agreement template editor with side-by-side sample-data preview

Rationale: preview must run injectAgreementClauses so the Bonzah addendum shows — otherwise operators paste it by hand and get it twice, because the idempotency guard matches the placeholder, not the prose
Fixed, non-deletable platform disclaimer (Drive247 / Cortek Systems Ltd is not a party to the rental agreement) appended to every template
E-signature field tokens {{@sig1}} / {{@date1}} / {{@init1}} rendered as placeholder chips in preview
Unsaved-changes navigation guard with save-and-leave, shared by the agreement and email template editors
The active template per category is what gets sent for electronic signing
Agreement templates settings page
Default-vs-custom template chooser for one category
Four agreement categories (standard, extension, payg, installment); the PAYG tab only appears when pay_as_you_go_enabled
Missing default/custom template rows are lazily provisioned on first page open, and an empty custom template cannot be selected
Rationale: PostgrestError instances stringify to '{}', so the catch destructures message/code/details/hint for a readable log
Editor header label mapping omits the installment category, so installment templates are titled 'Standard'
Apply form settings page
Canonical 7-step public apply wizard (about, driver, intent, financial, history, documents, review) and its per-step field list
Operators hide optional steps and promote individual fields to required; required steps cannot be hidden
Global blacklist page
Platform-wide protection rule: a customer blocked by 3+ rental companies is auto-blacklisted and cannot book with any tenant
Blacklist query is deliberately cross-tenant — it exposes other operators' block reasons and company names
Email template editor with subject line and sample-data preview
Template resolution chain: tenant custom row -> hook default -> codebase default constant
Email preview merges the 43 agreement variables with email-specific ones and overlays live tenant company fields
Email templates catalogue page
Static EMAIL_TEMPLATE_TYPES catalogue drives the list; a tenant row only exists once a template is customised
'Reset all' fires one sequential per-key reset mutation with no transaction or rollback
Lead management settings page
Lead settings are read straight from tenants but written only through an edge function — a deliberate read/write privilege split
Lead pipeline tuning: stale reminder hours, auto-lost hours, AI communication tone; automations require lead management on
Public per-tenant apply URL surfaced for sharing (getApplyUrl from the tenant slug)
Reminder engine settings page
Reminder engine knobs: timezone, send_time, upcoming/due/overdue toggles, max_overdue_reminders, warranty due/expiring/expired flags
reminder_settings is a flat setting_key/setting_value store read and upserted with no tenant predicate — one operator's change is global
Documented limitation: reminder delivery is in-app only; email and WhatsApp channels are not wired yet
'Respect credit coverage' suppresses payment reminders when prepaid customer credit already covers the charge
Staff users management page
All staff mutations (password reset, role change, activate/deactivate) go through service-role admin-* edge functions, never direct table writes
Page is gated client-side on appUser.role === 'head_admin'; real enforcement lives in the edge functions
Temporary passwords are generated in the browser with Math.random and shown/copied in plaintext
'Change Role' cycles viewer -> ops -> admin -> viewer only; the manager role and its per-tab permissions are unreachable here
Hand-rolled client-side CSV export (string join + Blob + anchor click) duplicated across five dashboard pages
List filters, pagination and view mode live in the URL search params, making dashboard state shareable and back-button safe
Money is always rendered via formatCurrency(amount, tenant?.currency_code || 'USD')
